# lan

Lists Centcom sessions on this network (mDNS; no account needed), or hosts one: `lan host` listens (--bind <ip>, --port <n>, --allow-wan, --no-announce), prints a one-time pairing code and the fingerprint, and runs until Ctrl-C.

```
centcom lan scan [--timeout 3] [--json] | host [--name <t>] [--port <n>]
```
